story: Once upon a time, a small duck named Pip lived by a blue lake. One warm morning, Pip saw tiny drops rise from the water and float up into the sky. "Where are you going?" asked Pip. The drops said, "We are evaporating! We will cool high up and make a soft cloud." Pip watched the cloud grow gray and gentle. Soon, cool rain fell on Pip's feathers. Pip laughed and swam as little streams ran back toward the lake. "The water came home," said Pip. From that day, Pip knew the water cycle: up from the lake, into clouds, down as rain, and back again.
notes: Seed SFT pair; covers all four water-cycle facts in simple narrative.
